page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the middle 50% tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1875.78 and a multi-core score of 15544.16. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 846.98 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 95.55 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 56.68 GB/sec. In database and application tests, the instance processes 15.82 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 21.07 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning, it processes 1299.46 prompt tokens per second on a 135M parameter LLM and 32.22 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model.

The instance provides a compute-dense profile with dedicated CPU allocation, making it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution without the overhead of hyperthreading. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs reduces baseline costs for pure compute tasks. This hardware configuration is suitable for compute-heavy workloads, including software compilation, web serving, database operations, and moderate-scale language model inference.
